title: Two Men and Toddler in Yard, 1945 Evansville IN B&W Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: Bill Summers Bill Oakley & Tommy Jr. 231 E. W. NEWMAN CO. CAMERA SHOP APR 21 1945 EVANSVILLE INDIANA
description: 1945 outdoor snapshot depicting two men, identified as Bill Summers and Bill Oakley, crouching outdoors beside a young toddler named Tommy Jr. Stamped by E. W. Newman Co. Camera Shop in Evansville, Indiana.
